Currently, {{ ydb-short-name }} supports only one method of LDAP user authentication — *search+bind*: after receiving the login and password, a service *bind* is performed on behalf of the [service account](#ldap-service-account-auth) (login and password in `bind_dn` or `bind_password`, or a certificate and SASL EXTERNAL — see the [configuration](../reference/configuration/auth_config.md#ldap-auth-config)), then a search for the user record and a second *bind* on behalf of the user.
